energy_summary.framing_note: SPWM's primary advantage over ANN-Rate is closed-loop dynamical stability (+23.4 pp PIL grasp success) and 1.0% sensory noise retention (4.3x better), not E2E energy savings (1.0979 mJ/step matches ANN-Rate; 48.14 nJ Loihi-2 core reduction is 0.004% of E2E power). The 4.94x Loihi-2 recurrent core reduction (12.22 +- 0.19 nJ/step, 0.244 mW @ 20 Hz, SOPs excluding passive leak) is an always-on standby state-estimation benefit when batched MPPI rollouts are dormant; the 1.93x E2E reduction vs. Continuous RSSM (2.1236 mJ/step) comes from M1's compact MLP rollout architecture.
